THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING AMENDED JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF CITY HOUSING , INC RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT TOMPKINS, RITA THE RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES: 520 SOUTH VAN NESS AVENUE #303 SAN FRANCISCO, CA., STAYED UNTIL JAN-14-2003, LEASE FORFEITED, SECURITY DEPOSIT DECLARED FORFEITED TO PLAINTIFF. EACH SIDE BEAR OWN COST AND ATTY. FEES. IF DEFENDANT FAILS TO VACATE PREMISE BY 1/14/03, PLTF. TO HAVE JUDGMENT FOR BACK RENT OF $1,462.00 AND UNLAWFUL DETAINER DAMAGES OF $11.60 PER DAY FROM 11/1/02 THROUGH 1/14/03 ALONG WITH COST OF $199.30 AND NO ATTORNEY FEES FOR A TOTAL AMENDED JUDGMENT OF $2,531.30. SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF THIS STIPULATED JUDGMENT UNLAWFUL DETAINER. (NOTE, THIS IS NOT AN AMENDED JUDGMENT).
